short: One of the Italian pioneers of electroconvulsive therapy.
note: Ugo Cerletti and Lucio Bini, Italian physicians who introduced electroconvulsive therapy in Rome in April 1938. Bini designed the original electrical apparatus.

short: An old term for a psychiatrist.
note: A physician who specializes in mental disorders; an older term for a psychiatrist.
German Blutsauger means a bloodsucker, literally or figuratively, and can mean a vampire.
Sigmund Freud (1856–1939), the Austrian physician who developed psychoanalysis, emphasizing unconscious mental processes and the interpretation of dreams.
